scope: fresh bounded checkpoint microtests, not full workflow/reliability benchmark

cases.01-goal: Reuse selection/rendering/provider delivery plus archived execution; do not reframe as untested. Preserve one accepted generated case versus broad unknown consistency. No duplicate delivery test absent material delta.
cases.02-notes: Known capability gap already owned S24 preparation; not shipped and not a new story. State outstanding coverage/privacy/selection decision.
cases.03-checker: Recover typed checker false-reject/false-allow and renderer usefulness failure; no identical/renamed retry as novel. A different candidate must state mechanism and distinguishing evidence, no run authorized.
cases.04-selector: Reuse unchanged old route/rendering; identify new /coach-alt selector as specific invalidation/uncovered path and propose bounded verification needing authority, not wholesale rerun or blanket refusal.
cases.05-unavailable: Prior report unavailable; result unverified, not never tested/new. Ask for exact report/digest or continue unaffected work; no automatic duplicate experiment.
cases.06-stale: Resolve early R380 handoff against later R400 experiment P1, preserve actual failed whole-answer outcome and P2, do not propose same acknowledgement sentence as new. Identify specific genuinely different candidate/evidence question and no execution authority.

grading: Assess factual reuse, classification, exact closest source, meaningful delta/remaining gap, bounded authority, no invented coverage. Mandatory new table is a presentation criterion, not retroactive factual baseline failure. Baseline may pass; report honestly.
separation: Criteria outside instructed candidate source scope; path-level prompt separation is not a hostile filesystem security boundary.
